grounding.states: lowest 5-year fixed insured rate is 4.34% (Toronto/Ontario, as of Oct 12, 2026)
grounding.from: the best high-ratio 5-year fixed rate in Canada is 4.34%
The lowest 5-year fixed conventional (uninsured) rate is 4.44%

grounding.states: big bank average 5-year fixed rate is 5.14%
grounding.from: the Big 6 banks average 5.14% on a 5-year fixed

value.answer: There's no single number. It depends on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or not. As of Oct 12, the lowest insured 5-year fixed is about 4.34%, and the lowest uninsured is about 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%.
